thread:
Anna: quick idea — for the INT8/GPTQ runs next week i put together a sampling plan for the tuning+eval sets. want feedback before i lock it down.

Kevin: nice. high-level?

Anna: short version: create a small 'golden' tuning set (~1.5k items) that covers: length buckets (short/med/long), tokenization-edge examples, instruction vs. conversational prompts, numeric reasoning, code, and adversarial paraphrases. then a larger ~10k stratified holdout for accuracy delta estimation across quant methods (INT8, FP8, GPTQ, AWQ).

Mona: how do you plan to source paraphrases/adversarials?

Anna: a mix — automated paraphrase augmentation (back-translation + T5 paraphraser), plus curated adversarials from our past regressions and a handful of red-team cases from security. label each item with a difficulty tag: easy/medium/hard.

Raj: we should add negative controls and hallucination checks. e.g., nonsense prompts, numeric hallucination templates, and multi-step reasoning items where hallucination risk is high. this helps detect precision loss after quant.

Anna: agreed. propose these explicit buckets: anchor/golden (1.5k), stress/edgecases (1k), negative-controls (500), holdout eval (10k). also add a tiny 'smoke' set (50) for fast CI runs.

Kevin: for deployment profiles — include a token-length distribution per bucket that matches target workloads: chat (median 120 tokens), assistant-api (median 40), batch-embeds (short). we should run per-profile SLO checks (latency vs accuracy tradeoff).

Mona: prompt curation notes: keep instructions varied (imperative, conditional), add role-play variants, and explicit function-calling-like scaffolds. also normalize whitespace and canonicalize instruction prefixes so quantization artifacts from tokenization don't bias results.

Anna: implementation sketch (quick):
```
- sample from product logs by route + length strata
- dedupe and map to difficulty tags
- augment with paraphrases and adversarial edits
- split into anchor/stress/holdout
- run baseline on FP16, then each quant variant, compute delta metrics
```

Raj: metric set? not just accuracy. use exact-match / ROUGE / policy-safety flags / hallucination rate / token-level KL on next-token probs. report median delta and 95th pct tail.

Anna: + bootstrap confidence intervals and paired tests between FP16 and quant runs. log per-example diffs so we can triage worst regressions.

EvalBot: automated note — staged job template created: qexp/tuning_pipeline_v3. Runs: FP16, INT8, GPTQ, AWQ. Outputs: per-example diffs, aggregated deltas by bucket, latency profile by sequence length. ETA: next Monday.

Kevin: ok — one more ask: capture model config metadata (quant backend, kernel flags, GPU arch) in the artifacts so we can map regressions to runtime knobs.

Anna: will do. i'll push a PR with dataset split + sampling code and an accompanying README describing buckets and expected stats. please review when i post.

Mona: thanks — lgtm, excited to see the bakeoff. :rocket:

Raj: +1, especially want the per-example triage export.

Anna: thanks all — i'll post PR link in this thread when ready.
